note: Source registry for the Deep South pilot (Conflict Coverage plan, Phase 1). One entry per source the Deep South job reads. permission.status: cleared (licence or terms checked and allow storage, translation and redistribution), nc (non-commercial use only, tagged so it can be stripped), link-only (store the link and metadata, no text), pending (not yet checked), excluded. A source's identity check says the account or site belongs to that publisher; it never says a report from it is true. tests/source_registry.test.mjs fails when a feed in tools/deepsouth_feeds.json has no entry here.
